# PRD — Initiative XX: [Initiative Name]

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Objective
- **Problem Statement:** What pain point or requirement does this initiative solve?
- **Proposed Solution:** High-level summary of the architectural and user-facing solution.
- **Success Criteria:** Measurable outcomes and acceptance criteria.

---

## 2. Technical Architecture & Data Model
- **Components Affected:** List frontend, backend, or database models modified.
- **Data Contracts & Schemas:** Types, interfaces, API endpoints, or database tables.
- **Security & Safety Guardrails:** Permissions, authentication, environment isolation.

---

## 3. Implementation Checklist & Execution Sequence
- [ ] **Phase 1: Architecture & Data Layer**
  - [ ] Task 1.1: Define types & interfaces
  - [ ] Task 1.2: Implement database operations / API endpoints
  - [ ] Task 1.3: Write automated unit / integration tests
- [ ] **Phase 2: UI & User Experience**
  - [ ] Task 2.1: Build frontend views / components
  - [ ] Task 2.2: Integrate state management & API hooks
  - [ ] Task 2.3: Add UI unit tests
- [ ] **Phase 3: QA & Verification**
  - [ ] Task 3.1: Run full test suite (`npm test`)
  - [ ] Task 3.2: Run static production build (`npm run build`)
  - [ ] Task 3.3: Open GitHub Pull Request
